steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The HR diagram plots luminosity (vertical axis, increasing upward) against temperature/spectral class (horizontal axis, decreasing left to right) | Key Fact: The main sequence runs diagonally from top-left (hot, luminous) to bottom-right (cool, dim) | Key Fact: Red giants appear in the upper-right: cool but very luminous due to large size | Key Fact: White dwarfs appear in the lower-left: hot but dim due to small size

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the hertzsprung-russell diagram, and one past-paper question.
